slides.title: Spontaneous speaking strategies
list: Buy time: *That's an interesting question… Let me think about that for a second.*
Structure on the go: *There are two sides to this…*
Reformulate: *What I'm trying to say is…*
Use examples from your own field.

slides.title: Your turn
body: Prepare a 5-minute presentation about a topic in your field (e.g. the future of animation). Record it and answer three questions a classmate asks you.
